# Memory

## R14-A1 Results (2026-05-19)

BA-optimal layer selection + HS vs Text probe, 60/20/20 split, 10k bootstrap, HB correction (12 tests).

**Note:** Script used `max_iter=500` (not 2000 as spec'd). Convergence warnings observed for some layers.

### Results Table

| Model | BA-opt Layer | HS Prec | Text Prec | ΔPrec | p | HS FPR | Text FPR | ΔFPR | p | HS BA | Text BA | ΔBA | p | HS AUROC | Text AUROC | ΔAUROC | p | HB 3/3? |
|-------|-------------|---------|-----------|-------|------|--------|----------|------|------|-------|---------|-----|------|----------|------------|--------|------|---------|
| R1-8B | L17 | 0.6330 | 0.4720 | +0.1857 | 0.0001 | 0.1135 | 0.2053 | -0.0703 | 0.0433 | 0.7371 | 0.6729 | +0.0842 | 0.0062 | 0.8568 | 0.7357 | +0.1211 | 0.0089 | 2/3 |
| OT-7B | L2 | 0.3767 | 0.2543 | +0.1849 | 0.0000 | 0.1811 | 0.2938 | -0.1334 | 0.0001 | 0.6569 | 0.5796 | +0.0802 | 0.0060 | 0.7325 | 0.6042 | +0.1282 | 0.0031 | 3/3 |
| R1-32B | L46 | 0.5582 | 0.4408 | +0.1284 | 0.0143 | 0.3064 | 0.3816 | -0.1217 | 0.0829 | 0.7225 | 0.6011 | +0.1757 | 0.0000 | 0.7880 | 0.6371 | +0.1508 | 0.0086 | 1/3 |
| QwQ-32B | L63 | 0.6598 | 0.4601 | +0.1812 | 0.0008 | 0.1341 | 0.2019 | -0.0644 | 0.0878 | 0.7628 | 0.6173 | +0.1348 | 0.0000 | 0.8397 | 0.6887 | +0.1510 | 0.0012 | 2/3 |

### HB Correction Details (12 tests, α=0.05)

| Test | raw p | adj p | reject |
|------|-------|-------|--------|
| R1-8B_precision | 0.0001 | 0.0009 | **Yes** |
| R1-8B_bal_acc | 0.0062 | 0.0360 | **Yes** |
| R1-8B_fpr | 0.0433 | 0.1299 | No |
| OT-7B_precision | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | **Yes** |
| OT-7B_bal_acc | 0.0060 | 0.0360 | **Yes** |
| OT-7B_fpr | 0.0001 | 0.0009 | **Yes** |
| R1-32B_precision | 0.0143 | 0.0572 | No |
| R1-32B_bal_acc | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | **Yes** |
| R1-32B_fpr | 0.0829 | 0.1658 | No |
| QwQ-32B_precision | 0.0008 | 0.0056 | **Yes** |
| QwQ-32B_bal_acc | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | **Yes** |
| QwQ-32B_fpr | 0.0878 | 0.1658 | No |

**Summary: 8/12 HB pass, 14/16 raw significant**

- All 4 models: precision and bal_acc show HS > Text (most survive HB)
- FPR: only OT-7B survives HB correction; R1-8B raw sig but not HB; R1-32B and QwQ-32B not even raw sig
- AUROC: all 4 raw significant (not in HB family)

### Key Observations
- BA-optimal layers vary widely: L2 (OT-7B), L17 (R1-8B), L46 (R1-32B), L63 (QwQ-32B)
- 32B models prefer very deep layers (L46, L63) while smaller models prefer shallower layers
- HS consistently outperforms Text across all models and metrics
- FPR advantage is the weakest signal (only 1/4 survives HB)

### Artifacts
- Full results: `/root/autodl-tmp/contrastive_trace_safety/artifacts/r14_a1_ba_layer_canonical/full_results.json`
- Per-model JSONs: `r1_8b_result.json`, `ot_7b_result.json`, `r1_32b_result.json`, `qwq_32b_result.json`
- Script: `src/experiments/exp_r14_a1_ba_layer.py`
